@graph.description: Trovi artifact that benchmarks CPU-only large language model inference on a single Chameleon instance, either a bare metal node or a virtual machine. The notebook launches an Ubuntu 24.04 instance, builds llama.cpp from source, and downloads a small quantized model. It then uses llama-bench to measure tokens per second across a sweep of thread counts sized to the instance. Results are downloaded and plotted in the notebook.
@graph.disambiguatingDescription: Benchmark CPU LLM inference scaling with llama.cpp on a bare metal or VM instance
@graph.name: CPU LLM Inference Scaling with llama.cpp
